newsitem.title: ST VINCENT: CRICKET-DE SILVA SPURS SRI LANKA TOWARDS VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DE SILVA SPURS SRI LANKA TOWARDS VICTORY.

text.p: Aravinda de Silva hit a rapid 76 not out to put Sri Lanka well on the way to victory over West Indies on the last day of the second and final test on Tuesday.
Chasing 269 to win, Sri Lanka were 179 for three at lunch. Captain Arjuna Ranatunga was the other not batsman on 34 and by the interval he and de Silva had added 61 for the fourth wicket.
Sri Lanka resumed at 97 for two and de Silva showed his intentions right from the start when he took two boundaries off fast bowler Ian Bishop's opening over.
He reached his half-century in exactly one hour from only 47 balls and hit nine fours.
Sri Lanka's only casualty before lunch was opener Roshan Mahanama who was caught by wicketkeeper Courtney Browne off Bishop.
